pc_crossplay.summary: Android-PC cross-play: the engine claims the PC client's executable checksum when the player's launcher switch has written gx_pc_compat.txt, and the launcher shows that switch.
pc_crossplay.why_off: Turned off on 18/10/2026 at the GeneralsOnline developers' request (Android clients slowed lockstep games for PC players; 3 of 9 test games desynced). Turn it on again only with their agreement.
pc_crossplay.read_by: engine 3278 and later (1.3.0 and 1.4.0 through the over-the-air engine); from the next release the engine reads it only from the signed manifest, whose signature it checks itself (GXSignedSettings), so a patched launcher or an edited remote_config.ini cannot turn it on; launchers after 1.4.0 for the card
pc_crossplay.unaware_builds: Engines before 3278 claim the PC checksum whenever the marker exists, whatever this says; only an engine update reaches them.
